/// The shape a `PathEffect` applies to, passed to its `update` alongside the
/// path: a `NodeData` for the shape, carrying the stroke or fill being drawn.
/// It is only valid during that `update` call; kept past it, it reads
/// nothing and its writes do nothing.
///
/// The paint is a snapshot of the stroke or fill: its style, thickness, cap,
/// join, solid color, feather and blend mode. Gradients are not included.
/// ```as
/// override update(path: Path, node: PathEffectNode): Path {
///     let paint = node.asPaint();
///     this.spacing = paint.thickness * 2;
///     return path;
/// }
/// ```
export class PathEffectNode extends NodeData {
    /// The stroke or fill the effect applies to.
    override get paint(): Paint;

    /// Returns the stroke or fill the effect applies to, the same as
    /// `paint`.
    override asPaint(): Paint;
}
